standard_prerequisites: the Separation axiom schema of Z
Russell's paradox on the set R = {x : x not in x}
core_obligations: Prove that the universal set {x : x = x} does not exist in Z
proof_roadmap: Suppose a universal set V exists; by Separation the Russell set R = {x in V : x not in x} exists
Separation gives R = {x : x not in x} outright, and the Russell contradiction applies to R
difficulty_reason: A textbook two-line reductio using Separation; short but the identification of the Separation instance with the full Russell set is the point.
